label: PRIVATE FORK of X Layer testnet 1952 (loopback Anvil, chain id 1952, auto-impersonation). Mock tokens, inventory-backed mock venue, mock ERC-4626 vault, development reference processor. These transactions exist only on the fork: they are NOT public transactions and must never be linked to an explorer.
driver: Playwright Chromium + injected test EIP-1193 provider reporting the public demo owner and forwarding to the fork, which signs by impersonation; no private key
build: production build (next build + next start) for chain 1952 with the private-fork label, RPC pointed at the fork; expansion manifests from a copy in which only vault-1952.json uiEnabled is true (the base v2 write switch is treated as on by the fork build)
scenario: a wallet that owns nothing on 1952: creates its own vault account, funds it by mint, sets limits, deposits, withdraws, redeems

appTransactions.label: fresh wallet: create its own vault account at the public vault factory
appTransactions.asserted: accountOf(fresh wallet) = 0x54D6f435C8830Cf579A5e65D0792AB71CE671E63, owner() = the wallet, adapter and vault as in the public manifest

appTransactions.label: fresh wallet: mint 12 test mUSDC to its vault account (the token's mint is open to anyone)
vault deposit limits: cap 1000 mUSDC, floor 1 share per asset
vault deposit 5
appTransactions.asserted: assets 5000000 in, shares +5000000 (minimum 4975000, quote 5000000); bound in calldata = bound shown (4975000); allowance to the vault 0

appTransactions.label: vault withdraw 2
appTransactions.asserted: assets 2000000 out, shares -2000000 (maximum 2010000, quote 2000000); bound in calldata = bound shown (2010000); allowance to the vault 0

appTransactions.label: vault redeem 3
appTransactions.asserted: shares 3000000 in, assets +3000000 (minimum 2985000, quote 3000000); bound in calldata = bound shown (2985000); allowance to the vault 0

appTransactions.label: redeem 1 share with a minimum of 10 mUSDC (eth_call as the owner, nothing sent)
Portfolio vault row equals the chain
